title: United List, National Alliance agree on government formation
summary_full: The current Prime Minister, Andris Kulbergs (United List), who has been entrusted by the President with forming a new government, has announced that the United List (AS) and the National Alliance (NA) have agreed to cooperate in forming the new government, Latvian Television reported Sunday evening.
